$comment: Advisories accepted for this MVP. Each entry must carry a reason and a review date; scripts/audit.ts fails CI on anything at or above the chosen severity that is NOT listed here. See DECISIONS.md D-CA-12.

allow.reason: Pinned to 3.3.11 by an `overrides` entry because the corporate registry blocks releases newer than ~14 days (TEAM-BRIEF hard rule 1). Transitive, build-time only: Next uses it for build ids, it is not reachable from any request path.
Pinned to 2.8.0 by the same registry policy. Browserslist data used at build time only; the advisory is a denial of service on malformed input that never reaches production.

Transitive build-time dependency of Tailwind 4. The advisories are source-map path traversal and CSS stringify escaping, both reachable only when compiling attacker-controlled CSS, which this repo never does.
Optional image-optimisation dependency of Next. This product serves no user-supplied images through next/image, and the runtime container is the standalone output.
devDependency pinned to 1.52.0 by TEAM-BRIEF. The advisory is in the browser installer script, which runs only on a developer machine or a CI runner, never in a deployment.
devDependency pinned to 3.2.4 by TEAM-BRIEF. The advisory affects the Vitest UI/API server, which this repo never starts (tests run with `vitest run`).
Transitive devDependency of Vitest. The advisory affects the esbuild dev server, which is never started here.
